{{Top|leg}}
A '''key-code chip reader''' was a type of [[Lock/Legends|locking]] mechanism. It was one of several methods that could be used to secure [[Binders/Legends|binders]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
